name: Placements
faqs: Will I get placement support after completing the program?
Yes. The program includes career support to help you prepare for the hiring process and explore relevant job opportunities.
Is placement guaranteed?
No. Placement is not guaranteed. However, you receive career support, interview preparation and access to relevant opportunities to help you pursue suitable roles.
What kind of career support will I get?
Career support includes areas such as resume building, interview preparation, career guidance and job-readiness support.
Will I get help with my resume?
Yes. Resume-building support is part of the career support provided during the program.
Will I get interview preparation?
Yes. Interview preparation is included as part of the career support.
Are mock interviews provided?
Yes. Mock interviews are part of the interview-preparation process.
Is GD preparation included?
Yes. Group Discussion (GD) training is included as part of the employability preparation.
Is Soft Skills training provided?
Yes. Soft Skills training is included to help you build communication, confidence and professional skills.
What is the Career Portal?
The Career Portal gives you continued access to career opportunities and job-search resources.
How long will I have access to the Career Portal?
Eligible programs provide up to 3 years of Career Portal access.
Is there a monthly Employability Test?
Yes. A monthly Employability Test is conducted to assess your job-readiness and track your progress.
What score do I need to become interview-ready?
The targeted score is approximately 70–75%.
What happens once I score 70–75%?
Once you achieve the targeted 70–75% score, you can start participating in relevant interview opportunities through the applicable career process.
Does scoring 70–75% guarantee a job?
No. It indicates that you have reached the expected level of interview readiness. Final selection depends on your interview performance and the employer's requirements.
What if I don't score 70–75%?
You can continue working on the areas where you need improvement and use the subsequent monthly assessments to track your progress.

name: Pricing
faqs: What is the registration amount?
The registration amount is ₹5,000.
What happens after I pay the ₹5,000 registration amount?
Your registration is initiated, and the amount is adjusted as per the applicable enrolment and fee structure.
Is the ₹5,000 registration amount part of the program fee?
Yes, the registration amount is adjusted against the applicable program fee as per the enrollment terms.
Is scholarship available?
Yes. Merit-based scholarships of up to 50% are available for eligible learners.
How can I get a scholarship?
You can appear for the upGrad Scholarship Test and become eligible for a scholarship based on your performance.
What is the Scholarship Test?
It is a 30-minute test with 15 questions carrying 15 marks, covering basic Aptitude and English.
What is the maximum scholarship I can get?
You can be eligible for up to 50% scholarship, depending on your performance and applicable eligibility criteria.
Is 50% scholarship guaranteed?
No. The scholarship amount depends on your performance in the Scholarship Test and the applicable scholarship criteria.
Can I pay the program fee in EMI?
Yes. EMI and other flexible payment options are available, subject to eligibility and the applicable plan.
What is No-Cost EMI?
No-Cost EMI allows you to pay the applicable program fee through instalments without additional interest being charged under the applicable no-cost plan.
What is Standard EMI?
Standard EMI allows you to spread the payment over a selected tenure, with interest applicable as per the financing plan.
What is the difference between No-Cost EMI and Standard EMI?

No-Cost EMI: No additional interest under the applicable no-cost plan.
Standard EMI: Interest may apply depending on the selected financing plan.
Is EMI available for everyone?
EMI is subject to eligibility and approval by the applicable lending partner.
Can I choose my EMI tenure?
Available tenures depend on the program, centre and financing partner.
Are there processing charges for EMI?
Processing fees may apply depending on the lending partner and selected plan.
Can I pay the entire program fee upfront?
Yes. An upfront payment option is available for applicable programs.
Does the fee remain the same at every centre?
The fee and payment options can vary by program, location and applicable offers, so the applicable centre pricing should be considered.

name: Certifications
faqs: Will I receive a certificate after completing the program?
Yes. You will receive the upGrad Program Certificate after successfully completing the applicable program requirements.
Will I get any additional certificates?

Depending on the program, you may also receive:
iHUB DivyaSampark, IIT Roorkee credential
IIIT-B Add-on Certificate
Guided Internship Certificate
NSDC Course Completion Certificate
The exact credentials depend on the program.
What is an add-on certificate?
An add-on certificate is an additional credential earned through a specific learning component or masterclass, in addition to the main program certificate.
Which programs have an IIIT-B Add-on Certificate?
The IIIT-B Add-on Certificate is available with selected programs, including applicable Data Science, Data Analytics, AI Pro and FutureStack programs.
How do I get the IIIT-B certificate?
You need to attend the applicable IIIT-B masterclass to receive the add-on certificate.
Is the IIIT-B certificate the main program certificate?
No. It is an additional certificate. The main credential is the applicable upGrad program certificate.
What is the Guided Internship Certificate?
It is a separate certificate provided after successfully completing the applicable guided internship.
What is the NSDC Course Completion Certificate?
It is an additional course-completion credential provided for applicable programs after meeting the required program criteria.
Is the iHUB DivyaSampark, IIT Roorkee credential available with every program?
No. It is available with the applicable iHUB programs.
Is the iHUB DivyaSampark credential an IIT Roorkee degree?
No. It is a credential associated with iHUB DivyaSampark, IIT Roorkee and is not an IIT Roorkee degree.
Do certifications guarantee a job?
No. Certifications add value to your profile but do not guarantee employment or placement.

name: Quality of Teachers
faqs: Who conducts the regular classes?
Regular classes are conducted through classroom-based learning at the upGrad Learning Support Centre, with experienced trainers and subject-matter experts.
Who conducts the masterclasses?
Masterclasses are conducted by industry experts and, where applicable, faculty from partner institutions.
Are the masterclasses online or offline?
Masterclasses are conducted online, while the regular program is delivered through classroom training.
Will I learn from industry professionals?
Yes. The programs include industry-led masterclasses and expert sessions, along with the regular classroom learning.

name: Number of Classes
faqs: How often are the regular classes conducted?
Regular classes are conducted between Monday to Saturday.
How long is each class?
Regular classroom sessions are approximately 2 hours per day.
Are there classes on weekends?
Yes. Weekend sessions include Aptitude, GD and Soft Skills training.
What happens if I miss a class?
You can access the recording of the classroom session to catch up on the topic covered.
Will I get recordings of the classroom sessions?
Yes. Recordings are provided for missed sessions and revision.

name: Course Structure
faqs: Are the classes online or offline?
The program follows a hybrid learning model. Regular classes are conducted offline at the Learning Support Centre, while masterclasses are conducted online by industry experts.
Is this a classroom-based program?
Yes. The core program is delivered through classroom training at the Learning Support Centre. upGrad describes its Offline LSC offering as classroom training with career support.
Is the program completely online?
No. The regular program is classroom-based. Only certain components, such as masterclasses, are conducted online.
Is the program completely offline?
No. It follows a hybrid model, with regular classroom sessions and online masterclasses.
What happens if I miss a class?
You can use the class recording to catch up on the missed session.
Can I use the recordings for revision?
Yes. The recordings can also be used to revisit concepts covered in class.
What is the difference between regular classes and masterclasses?
Regular classes focus on the core program learning and are conducted at the centre. Masterclasses are specialised sessions conducted online by industry experts or partner-institution faculty.
Do I need to come to the centre for masterclasses?
No. Masterclasses are conducted online.
Are Aptitude, GD and Soft Skills included?
Yes. These are included as part of the overall learning and employability journey.
Why are Aptitude and Soft Skills included in a technical program?
The aim is to prepare you for the complete hiring process—not just the technical assessment. These sessions help build aptitude, communication, confidence and interview readiness.
What does a typical learning week look like?

You have regular classroom learning Monday to Saturday, with approximately 2 hours of learning each day. Weekend sessions focus on Aptitude, GD and Soft Skills, while online masterclasses are scheduled as applicable.
What will I learn in the Data Science program?
The program covers Python, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI and LLMs, along with data analysis, visualisation and predictive modelling. (upGrad)
Do I need prior coding experience?
No. The program is designed to be beginner-friendly, and prior coding experience is not required. (upGrad)
Will I work on projects?
Yes. You will work on hands-on projects, live industry projects and capstone projects. (upGrad)
How long is the program?
The program is designed for approximately 6 months. (upGrad)
Is the program suitable for working professionals?
Yes. The program is designed for graduates, early professionals and career switchers as well. (upGrad)
What will I learn in Full Stack Development?
You will learn the skills required to build both the front end and back end of web applications, along with relevant development tools and technologies.
Do I need prior coding experience?
No prior coding background is required for the applicable Full Stack program.
What will I build during the program?
The program focuses on practical development and project-based learning, allowing you to build applications and a portfolio.
How long is the program?
The iHUB Full Stack program is 6 months. (upGrad)
Do I need a marketing background to join?
No. The program is open to learners from different educational and professional backgrounds.
Do I need coding knowledge?
No technical background is required for the Digital Marketing program. (upGrad)
What will I learn in Digital Marketing?
The program covers areas such as SEO, SEM, social media marketing, content marketing, performance marketing, analytics and AI-powered marketing tools. (upGrad)
How long is the program?
The Accelerated Digital Marketing program is 4 months. (upGrad)
What will I learn in Data Analytics?
You will work with Excel, SQL, Python, Power BI and Tableau, along with Generative AI applications for data analysis and workflow automation. (upGrad)
Will I work on practical projects?
Yes. The program includes live projects and practical learning. (upGrad)
Do I need a technical background?
The eligibility depends on the program criteria, but the course is designed to build the required skills through structured learning.
How long is the program?
The program is 4 months. (upGrad)
What will I learn in AI Pro?
The program focuses on Generative AI and Agentic AI, including practical applications of modern AI tools and workflows.
Do I need prior experience in Generative AI?
No prior Generative AI or Agentic AI experience is required.
Will I get practical exposure?
Yes. The program focuses on hands-on learning and practical applications of Generative AI and Agentic AI.
How long is the program?
AI Pro is a 3-month program. (upGrad)
What is FutureStack?
FutureStack combines Data Science fundamentals with Generative AI, giving learners exposure to both data-driven problem solving and modern AI applications.
Do I need prior coding or Data Science experience?
No prior Data Science experience is required. Basic mathematics or logical reasoning can be helpful. (upGrad)
What will I learn?
The program combines Data Science concepts with Generative AI tools and applications.
How long is FutureStack?
FutureStack is a 3-month program. (upGrad)
What will I learn in Full Stack Development?
The program covers front-end and back-end development, databases, data structures and algorithms, and the MERN stack. (upGrad)
Do I need coding experience?
No prior coding experience is required for the applicable beginner-friendly program.
What kind of projects will I work on?
You will work on practical development projects that help you build a portfolio and apply the concepts covered in the program.
How long is the program?
The Certificate in Full Stack Development is 6 months. (upGrad)
What is CGIBO?
CGIBO stands for Certificate in Global & Investment Banking Operations. It is designed to build knowledge and practical skills relevant to global and investment banking operations.
Who can join the CGIBO program?
Eligibility depends on the applicable program criteria and learner profile.
What will I learn?
The program focuses on the knowledge and skills required to understand global and investment banking operations and related processes.
What kind of roles can I explore after completing the program?
Depending on your background and performance, you can explore relevant opportunities in banking operations and related financial-services roles.
